title: Entirely
summary: ENTI'RELY, adverb Wholly; completely; fully; as, the money is entirely lost. 1. In the whole; without division. Euphrates--falls not entirely into the Persian sea. 2. With firm adherence or devotion;

inlines.v: ENTI'RELY, adverb Wholly; completely; fully; as, the money is entirely lost. 1. In the whole; without division. Euphrates--falls not entirely into the Persian sea. 2. With firm adherence or devotion; faithfully.
